about: [C5] after the critic: III's fixes by real input - the pad (the hand drawn back off the figures with LMB up; tear-off as soon as the figures read: 0.55 of each ring), the dial (the index stopped ON 36 from above sets the gate), the check (the line names the desk; the two cards, drag then turn, as the pieces go down), and no rain indoors (the corridor's first frame). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/office_fixes.json

steps.name: no rain indoors: the corridor's first frame
the pad: rub, then LMB up - the hand draws back

steps.label: LMB up: the hand off the sheet

steps.name: the pad's tear-off: readable at 0.55 of each figure's ring (a demo hand scrubs)
the dial: the index stopped on 36 from above

steps.look: (() => { const r = G.scenes.ctx.flags.safe.reading; let d = r - 36.22; if (d < 3) d += 100; return [Math.round(d / 0.075), 0]; })()

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ reading: +G.scenes.ctx.flags.safe.reading.toFixed(2), gate: G.scenes.ctx.flags.safe.gate, stage: G.scenes.ctx.flags.safe.stage, dir: G.scenes.ctx.flags.safe.dir })

steps.name: the check: the line names his desk; the cards as the pieces go down

steps.expect: G.hud.objectiveText === 'Lay it out on his desk.'
steps.label: the line names the desk

steps.look: (() => { const e = G.eye, c = G.controller; const yaw = Math.atan2(-(3.92 - e.x), -(3.9 - e.z)), pitch = Math.atan2(0.8 - e.y, Math.hypot(3.92 - e.x, 3.9 - e.z)); const w = (a) => Math.atan2(Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a)); return [Math.round(-w(yaw - c.yaw) / c.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pitch - c.pitch) / c.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.name: the desk's things from in front of it: the pencil in his open drawer; his drawer shut from behind his chair

steps.eval: (() => { const O = G.stage.part('office'), s = G.scenes.ctx.flags.s; s.key = true; s.ames = true; const R1 = O.desk.drawers.find((d) => d.id === 'R1'); R1.locked = false; O.drawer(R1, true); return 1; })()

steps.look: (() => { const p = G.stage.part('office').pencil.getWorldPosition(new N.THREE.Vector3()); const e = G.eye, c = G.controller; const yaw = Math.atan2(-(p.x - e.x), -(p.z - e.z)), pitch = Math.atan2(p.y - e.y, Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z)); const w = (a) => Math.atan2(Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a)); return [Math.round(-w(yaw - c.yaw) / c.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pitch - c.pitch) / c.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.label: from the desk's front: take the pencil
